description_en: Returns the details of a specific cluster
description_zh: 查看指定集群的详细信息
name: DescribeDBClusterAttribute

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">The ID of an Enterprise Edition, Basic Edition, or Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>
<props="intl">The ID of the Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html operation to obtain the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版的集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html接口可以查询集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

DBCluster.description_en:
<props="china">The information about the Enterprise Edition and Basic Edition clusters.</props>
<props="intl">The information about the Data Lakehouse Edition clusters.</props>
DBCluster.description_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版集群信息列表。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群信息列表。</props>

AINodeSpec.description_en: The specifications of the AI nodes

ClickhouseEngineCacheSize.description_en: The cache size of the ClickHouse wide table engine, in GB. A value of -1 indicates that the wide table engine is disabled
ClickhouseEngineCacheSize.description_zh: ClickHouse宽表引擎的缓存大小，单位：GB。若返回-1，则表示未开启宽表引擎。 若返回具体数字，则表示云盘缓存空间大小

ClickhouseEngineEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the ClickHouse wide table engine is enabled.

true: The ClickHouse wide table engine is enabled.

false: The ClickHouse wide table engine is not enabled
ClickhouseEngineEnabled.description_zh:
ClickHouse宽表引擎是否开启。
true: 已开启Clickhouse宽表引擎。
false: 未开启Clickhouse宽表引擎

CommodityCode.description_en:
The commodity code of the cluster, which is the same as the code of the cluster on the Billing Management page. Valid values:

ads: A pay-as-you-go cluster.

ads_pre: A subscription cluster
CommodityCode.description_zh:
商品付费类型，取值说明：
ads：按量付费商品。
ads_pre：包年包月商品

ComputeResource.description_en: The amount of reserved computing resources. One AnalyticDB Compute Unit (ACU) is equivalent to approximately 1 core and 4 GB of memory. Computing resources are used for data computation. Increasing these resources can accelerate queries. You can scale the resources on demand based on the actual performance of the cluster
ComputeResource.description_zh: 计算预留资源规格。1 ACU约等于1核4 GB。计算资源用于数据计算，增加计算资源能加快查询速度，可以根据集群实际性能按需弹性扩缩

ComputeResourceTotal.description_en: The total amount of computing resources in the cluster
ComputeResourceTotal.description_zh: 集群计算总资源量。1 ACU约等于1核4 GB

ConnectionString.description_en: The VPC endpoint of the cluster

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the cluster was created. The time is in the `yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ` format and is displayed in UTC
CreationTime.description_zh: 集群创建时间。UTC时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ`

DBClusterId.description_en:
<props="china">The ID of the Enterprise Edition, Basic Edition, or Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>
<props="intl">The ID of the Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>
DBClusterId.description_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版的集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</prop

DBClusterNetworkType.description_en: The network type of the cluster. Only VPC (Virtual Private Cloud) is supported
DBClusterNetworkType.description_zh: 集群网络类型。仅支持VPC（专有网络）类型

DBClusterStatus.description_en:
The status of the cluster. Valid values:

Preparing: The cluster is being prepared.

Creating: The cluster is being created.

Running: The cluster is running.

Deleting: The cluster is being deleted.

Restoring: The cluster is being restored from a backup.

ClassChanging: The cluster specifications are being changed.

NetAddressCreating: A network connection is being created.

NetAddressDeleting: A network connection is being deleted.

NetAddressModifying: A network connection is being modified
DBClusterStatus.description_zh:
集群状态。取值说明：
Preparing：准备中
Creating：创建中
Running：运行中
Deleting：删除中
Restoring：备份恢复中
ClassChanging：变配中
NetAddressCreating：创建网络中
NetAddressDeleting：删除网络中
NetAddressModifying：修改网络中

DBClusterType.description_en: The type of the cluster. The default value is Common, which indicates a regular cluster
DBClusterType.description_zh: 集群类型。默认返回Common，表示常规集群

DBVersion.description_en: The version of the AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster. Currently, only version 5.0 is supported
DBVersion.description_zh: AnalyticDB MySQL集群的版本，当前仅支持5.0版本

DiskEncryption.description_en:
Indicates whether disk encryption is enabled. Valid values:

true: Disk encryption is enabled.

false: Disk encryption is not enabled
DiskEncryption.description_zh:
是否开启云盘加密。取值：

true：是。
false：否

Engine.description_en: The database engine of the cluster. The value is always AnalyticDB

EngineVersion.description_en: The engine version of the cluster

ExpireTime.description_en:
The expiration time of the cluster.

If the cluster is a subscription cluster, the expiration time is returned.

If the cluster is a pay-as-you-go cluster, an empty string is returned
ExpireTime.description_zh:
集群到期时间。
若集群付费类型为包年包月，则返回实际到期时间。
若集群付费类型为按量付费，则返回为空

Expired.description_en:
Indicates whether the subscription cluster has expired. Valid values:

true: The cluster has expired.

false: The cluster has not expired.

If a cluster expires, the cluster is locked or even released after a period of time. We recommend that you renew the cluster. For more information, see [Renewal]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135248.html）.

This parameter is not returned for pay-as-you-go clusters
Expired.description_zh:
包年包月集群是否过期。取值说明：
true：已过期。
false：未过期。
如果集群已过期，在一定时间内集群会被锁定甚至释放。建议您进行续费操作，详情请参见[续费说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135248.html）。
按量付费集群不返回此参数

KmsId.description_en:
The key ID used for disk encryption.

This parameter is returned only when disk encryption is enabled for the AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
KmsId.description_zh:
用于加密云盘数据的密钥ID。
仅当AnalyticDB MySQL集群开启云盘加密时才会返回该参数

LockMode.description_en:
The lock mode of the cluster. Valid values:

Unlock: The cluster is not locked.

ManualLock: The cluster is manually locked.

LockByExpiration: The cluster is automatically locked due to expiration
LockMode.description_zh:
集群的锁定模式，取值说明：
Unlock：未锁定。
ManualLock：手动触发锁定。
LockByExpiration：集群到期自动锁定

LockReason.description_en:
The reason why the cluster is locked.

This parameter is returned only when the cluster is locked. The value is always instance_expire
LockReason.description_zh:
集群锁定原因。
仅当集群被锁定时会返回该参数，固定为instance_expire

MaintainTime.description_en:
The maintenance window of the cluster. The time is in the `HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ` format and is displayed in UTC.

For more information about maintenance windows, see [Set a maintenance window]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122569.html）
MaintainTime.description_zh:
集群的可维护时间。UTC时间，格式为`HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ`。
更多关于可维护时间段的信息，请参见[设置可维护时间段]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122569.html）

Mode.description_en: The mode of the cluster. The default value is flexible, which indicates an elastic mode cluster
Mode.description_zh: 集群模式。默认返回flexible，表示弹性模式集群

PayType.description_en:
The billing method of the cluster. Valid values:

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.

Prepaid: subscription
PayType.description_zh:
集群付费类型，取值说明：
Postpaid：按量付费。
Prepaid：包年包月

Port.description_en: The port number of the cluster

ProductForm.description_en: This parameter is reserved for future use

ProductVersion.description_en:
The product version of the cluster. Valid values:

BasicVersion: Basic Edition.

EnterpriseVersion: Enterprise Edition
ProductVersion.description_zh:
产品版本。取值为：
BasicVersion：基础版。
EnterpriseVersion：企业版

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the cluster

ReservedACU.description_en: The amount of available reserved computing resources in the cluster
ReservedACU.description_zh: 集群剩余可分配计算预留资源。1 ACU约等于1核4 GB

ReservedNodeCount.description_en: This parameter is reserved for future use

ReservedNodeSize.description_en: This parameter is reserved for future use

SecondaryVSwitchId.description_en: The ID of the secondary vSwitch

SecondaryZoneId.description_en: The ID of the secondary zone

StorageResource.description_en: The amount of reserved storage resources. These resources are used for data reads and writes. Increasing them can improve the cluster's read and write performance
StorageResource.description_zh: 存储预留资源规格。1 ACU约等于1核4 GB。存储资源用于数据读写，增加该资源能提高集群读写能力

StorageResourceTotal.description_en: The total amount of storage resources in the cluster
StorageResourceTotal.description_zh: 集群存储总资源量。1 ACU约等于1核4 GB

additionalProperties.description_en: This parameter is reserved for future use

SupportedFeatures.description_en: This parameter is reserved for future use

Key.description_en:
The tag key.

To add tags to the cluster, call the [TagResources]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179253.html） operation
Key.description_zh:
标签键。
您可以调用[TagResources]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179253.html）接口为目标集群创建标签

Progress.description_en: The progress of the task, in percentage

Status.description_en:
The status of the task. Valid values:

NOT_RUN: The task is waiting to run.

RUNNING: The task is running.

SUCCEED: The task is complete
Status.description_zh:
任务状态，取值为：
NOT_RUN：等待运行。
RUNNING：运行中。
SUCCEED：已结束

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the step. The time is in the `yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ` format and is displayed in UTC
EndTime.description_zh: 步骤结束时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the step. The time is in the `yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ` format and is displayed in UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 步骤开始时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

StepProgress.description_en: The progress of the step, in percentage

StepStatus.description_en:
The status of the step. Valid values:

NOT_RUN: The step is waiting to run.

RUNNING: The step is running.

SUCCEED: The step is complete
StepStatus.description_zh:
步骤状态，取值为：
NOT_RUN：等待运行。
RUNNING：运行中。
SUCCEED：已结束

UserENIStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether an elastic network interface (ENI) is enabled. Valid values:

true: An ENI is enabled.

false: An ENI is not enabled
UserENIStatus.description_zh:
是否已启用ENI（Elastic Network Interface，弹性网卡）网络，取值说明：
true：已启用。
false：未启用

UserENIVSwitchOptions.description_en: The vSwitch IDs for the ENI. Multiple IDs are separated by commas (,)
UserENIVSwitchOptions.description_zh: ENI交换机列表。多个交换机中间用英文逗号（,）分隔

UserENIVpcId.description_en: The VPC information of the ENI

UserENIZoneOptions.description_en: The zone IDs for the ENI. Multiple IDs are separated by commas (,)
UserENIZoneOptions.description_zh: ENI可用区信息。多个可用区之间用英文逗号（,）分隔

ZoneId.description_en: The zone ID of the cluster
